changes: Hardened Koala validate command handling, JSON argument failure reporting coverage, doctor validation scan, fallback validation status, and reviewer/channel evidence gates without adding PVSC-specific assumptions.
usage: Run node packages/main/dist/cli.js validate --json or koala validate --json to see structured receipts; run node packages/main/dist/cli.js doctor to inspect Validation scan and fallback/configured command state.
expectedOutcome: Configured validate.command receipts clearly show command, shell, code, durationMs, and output; invalid JSON schema errors fail loudly; fallback validation success is PASS with advisory details, not WARN noise.
actualTranscript: npm run build passed; validation-protocol, flow-stability, and review-pass-discard smoke tests passed; validate --channel, --concept, --lint all passed; validate --story=B-2065 --json reported status pass, warnings [], and Verification intent coverage 15/15 covered.
outcomeDiff: No product-level difference from expected; the only advisory text left is explicit fallback discovery detail in summary/details, not a warn status.
limitations: Dashboard DONE-success/DONE-blocked/DONE-audit-only and spike verdict evidence were intentionally not implemented in this story; they should be separate outcome-semantics work.
pitfalls: Global koala can point at the main checkout instead of the story worktree, so verification used node packages/main/dist/cli.js for current-code evidence; finding_resolve is REVIEW-only, not DEV.
